job.question: Which retirement system's investment consultant RFP requires firms to certify that they currently provide investment consulting services to clients whose combined assets total at least $50 billion?
job.expected_facts: Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois (TRS Illinois), in its FY23 investment consultant RFP (Appendix B, Statement of Minimum Qualifications).
job.acceptance: TRS Illinois / Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois is sufficient; FY23 and appendix identifier are optional.

reviews.reason: This is an investment consultant RFP for the City of Grand Rapids retirement systems, not TRS Illinois. Its minimum requirements do not include certification that a firm currently consults for clients with combined assets of at least $50 billion.
quotes: CITY OF GRAND RAPIDS GENERAL RETIREMENT SYSTEM CITY OF GRAND RAPIDS POLICE AND FIRE RETIREMENT SYSTEM INVESTMENT CONSULTANT SERVICES REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (“RFP”)
The Investment Consultant must provide services to at least one (1) public employee retirement system with at least $250 million in assets.
